Synopsis:
Around 1,500 Unite members employed by Arriva North London have resumed a four-day strike over excessive cab temperatures, after drivers at three of eight garages rejected a proposed air conditioning upgrade deal. The core concern is that fleet-wide AC improvements across 730 buses may not be delivered before summer 2027. Further stoppages are planned for eight occasions in September and October. The dispute centres on worker safety under recurring extreme heat, with cab temperatures reportedly exceeding 40°C during this year's heatwaves.
